description: Japan Hospitals and Prefecture Health Facts. Japan's hospital landscape in one API, built from the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare FY2024 DPC discharge-patient survey and official prefecture statistics. Routes: /mdc; /gaps (by, limit, offset); /rank (by, order, limit, offset); /facts (topic, pref, sort, limit, offset); /summary; /hospitals (pref, q, city_code, dpc_status, min_beds, max_beds, mdc, min_cases, sort, limit, offset); /mdc/{mdc} (pref, sort, limit, offset); /prefectures (sort, limit, offset); /facts/topics; /cities/{city_code}; /prefectures/{pref}; /hospitals/{hospital_id}; /prefectures/{pref}/facts; /hospitals/{hospital_id}/mdc; /prefectures/{pref}/hospitals (limit, offset); /hospitals/{hospital_id}/profile; /prefectures/{pref}/health-profile. Paid $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /mdc, /gaps, /rank, /facts, /summary, /hospitals, /mdc/{mdc}, /prefectures, /facts/topics, /cities/{city_code}, /prefectures/{pref}, /hospitals/{hospital_id}, /prefectures/{pref}/facts, /hospitals/{hospital_id}/mdc, /prefectures/{pref}/hospitals, /hospitals/{hospital_id}/profile, /prefectures/{pref}/health-profile. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.
